thread:
Diego (AE): Quick sync — Cosmos POC ask from Finance. Need to lock prompt inventory, acceptance criteria, and any enterprise blockers before we send SOW.
Tom (Sales Eng): TL;DR: customer wants semantic search + extractive answer flow over private docs. POC scope = 10k docs, 2 query types (search + chat).
Asha (Solutions): Agree. We should define a baseline prompt set (10 prompts per query type) and 3 eval cohorts: exact-match, relevance, hallucination check.
Priya (CSE): Also clarifying timeline: customer expects results in 4 weeks. Proposal: week1 prompt collection & infra setup, week2 integration + ingest, week3 baseline evals, week4 tuning + final report. OK?
Diego (AE): Sounds reasonable. Finance asked about pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted for POC. Any quick numbers?
Tom (Sales Eng): For short POC, Hosted usage-based estimate: ~$800–1200 for expected tokens. Dedicated trial (reserved) minimum monthly commit is higher — recommend Hosted for speed unless they need VPC.
Asha (Solutions): Security checklist: must confirm S3 ingestion pattern, KMS key usage, and if logs are allowed. Customer needs data not to leave VPC — they said 'sensitive'. That likely pushes to Private or Dedicated with VPC peering.
Priya (CSE): Can we propose an isolated endpoint option? If they want Private it's a longer lead (2–3 weeks infra). Flag to sales.
Diego (AE): Customer also asked for acceptance criteria. Draft from us: 1) Relevance precision@5 >= 0.75, 2) Hallucination rate < 5% on targeted eval set, 3) p50 latency for chat < 400ms, 4) end-to-end throughput 10 qps sustained for search route.
Tom (Sales Eng): Add: cost-per-1k-tokens under $X (we should fill with estimate based on model). Also include fallback policy: if latency breach -> degrade to smaller quantized model.
Asha (Solutions): Prompt inventory starter (we'll collect examples from customer):
```
- Search query: "Find customer onboarding steps for plan X"
- Chat prompt: "Summarize policy changes in doc titled 'Pricing Addendum'"
- Extraction: "Return license term and renewal window as JSON"
- Relevance probe: "Is this doc about refunds?"
```
Include edge cases: long context pages, scanned PDFs, tables.
Priya (CSE): Eval plan: 100 labeled QAs per cohort, mix of short/long answers, golden labels provided by customer where possible. We'll run A/B vs baseline prompts and log token usage.
Diego (AE): Can we also list blockers for legal/security review? They asked about SOC2, data residency, and contractual DPA.
Tom (Sales Eng): Blockers: DPA signed, KMS access for private deploys, IP/treatment of derived embeddings. Legal typically needs a short review (48–72h) once DPA draft sent.
Asha (Solutions): Engineering asks: sample size for prefix caching, expected typical seq length (they said avg 350 tokens), and if they accept quantized 4-bit models. That affects latency and cost.
Priya (CSE): Operational acceptance: provide runbook + rollback plan, and test deck (smoke tests) that we run at cutover.
Diego (AE): Action items: 1) I will request prompt samples + golden answers from customer by EOD tomorrow. 2) Tom — send Hosted cost estimate + Dedicated delta. 3) Asha — prepare minimal security checklist & note if Private needed. 4) Priya — draft eval rubric and smoke tests.
Tom (Sales Eng): Will share cost ballpark in thread.
Asha (Solutions): I'll sketch the checklist and mark items that force Private deployment.
Priya (CSE): I'll prepare a 10-query starter eval set template we can drop into their data.
eng-deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: none (bot note)
Diego (AE): Great. If no objections I'll convert this into a one-pager to attach to SOW. :thumbsup:
Tom (Sales Eng): :thumbsup:
Asha (Solutions): :+1:
